name: Greenlawn Plaza
summary: Greenlawn Plaza is a community shopping center in Greenlawn, NY, managed by Federal Realty Investment Trust. The center offers a convenient mix of national retailers and local businesses serving the North Shore Long Island community with a 4.3-star customer rating.
demographics: Greenlawn Plaza serves the affluent North Shore Long Island community, attracting middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes typically ranging from $100,000 to $200,000+. The primary trade area draws from Greenlawn, Centerport, and surrounding Huntington Township neighborhoods, with shoppers predominantly aged 35-65 who value convenience and quality. The center caters to busy professionals and families seeking everyday necessities combined with specialty retail and dining options in a well-maintained, accessible location.
description: Greenlawn Plaza is a well-established community shopping center located at 777 Pulaski Road in Greenlawn, New York, serving the prosperous North Shore communities of Long Island. Owned and operated by Federal Realty Investment Trust, a premier publicly-traded REIT with a distinguished portfolio of high-quality retail properties across the United States, the center benefits from professional management and ongoing investment in its facilities. The plaza offers convenient access to a diverse mix of national retailers, local businesses, dining establishments, and essential services that cater to the daily needs of area residents. With operating hours from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, Greenlawn Plaza provides a comfortable, open-air shopping environment that has earned a strong 4.3-star rating from over 348 customer reviews. The center's strategic location on Pulaski Road ensures excellent visibility and accessibility for the surrounding Huntington Township communities, making it a reliable neighborhood destination for both routine shopping trips and specialty retail needs.
